items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: he did a lot of arranging for them. He wrote a lot of arrangements them for small groups like that.

ctx.x: Yeah, in L.A. there. And he used that little boy who got that little seven or eight piece band there in Los Angeles. (?)Jimmy Wynn(?).

I heard some records T-Bone made in the late '40s and the early 50's. And he had a little band, a tenor... Or it might have been alto. I think tenor, trumpet and rhythm section and T-Bone. And I tell you, you would have blown that tenor player out of the room.
